purpose: Locate one engineering ISL-pressure bracket without treating zero-rate, disconnection, access failure, NO_ROUTE growth or incomplete drain as congestion.

ordered_classification.when: Any physical-validity condition fails, including new access, geometry, outage, NO_ROUTE, data-overflow or control-plane failure evidence.
ordered_classification.action: Stop the bandwidth bracket. Do not call the result congestion. Move only to a separately preregistered traffic or OD-hotspot axis under physically plausible links.

ordered_classification.when: Physical validity passes but either drain-validity condition fails.
ordered_classification.action: Do not run 1 MHz and do not compare algorithms. Repeat the same candidate with unchanged emission and a separately reviewed longer observation/drain horizon.

ordered_classification.when: Physical and drain validity pass, and one directed ISL has at least two consecutive eligible 1 s windows at utilization >= 0.8 plus same-link matched queue wait >= 0.1 s and >= 100000 bit-s.
ordered_classification.action: Stop the bandwidth bracket. Freeze the engineering onset statement to the interval between 5 MHz and 2 MHz; do not infer a dose-response curve or a 1 MHz result. Confirm the adjacent bracket with preregistered seeds before any paper claim.

ordered_classification.when: Physical and drain validity pass but PRESSURE_CANDIDATE does not.
ordered_classification.action: Create R04 as 2 MHz versus 1 MHz with the same trace, seed, routing, topology, access, demand, horizon and this unchanged decision contract.

claim_boundary: This single-seed bracket is an engineering calibration, not a statistical effect estimate.
Bandwidth changes noise, SNR, MCS and control service time as physical consequences; it is not a pure capacity multiplier.
Utilization without same-link queue waiting is insufficient for a pressure classification.
A result selected by this tree cannot support algorithm superiority, information value, Q0 optimality or a new-algorithm claim.
